initialExam.title: Railway Staff Nurse (RRB Paramedical) 2026
initialExam.description: Indian Railways recruits Staff Nurses and paramedical staff for railway hospitals and health centers across zones.
initialExam.eligibility: B.Sc Nursing / GNM with valid registration
initialExam.syllabus: Professional knowledge (Nursing), GK, Arithmetic, General Science.
initialExam.selectionProcess: CBT → Document Verification → Medical → Final Merit
initialExam.jobRole: Staff Nurse in Indian Railway hospitals
initialExam.careerGrowth: Staff Nurse → Nursing Superintendent → Chief Matron.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit rrbcdg.gov.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, NPA, Free rail pass, Medical, Pension, Quarters
